items.title: How HISD is Creating Voter-Friendly Campuses
items.summary: This November, 92% of eligible 18-year-olds at Yates High School registered to vote, a success district officials attributed to going beyond state requirements with targeted registration plans customized to each campus.
items.alt: Yates High School marching to polls

items.title: HISD Students Turn Civic Learning Into Community Action
items.summary: Funded by the Houston Endowment, HISD's "My Ballot, My Future" initiative empowers students through civic engagement training, equipping them to return to their campuses and create meaningful opportunities for their peers.

items.title: The Next Generation of Storytellers Preserving Jack Yates HS’s History
items.summary: As seniors Hannah Estrada, Maja King, and Jariah Authorlee develop projects commemorating the school's centennial, they consider their contributions to its legacy of pride.

items.title: HISD’s Virtual Launchpad Gives Students Power to Shape High School Experience
items.summary: Four months in, sophomore Enzo Rodriguez Gomez said he already notices being more focused on his academics and having more time to dedicate to soccer and his long-time friend group at Heights High School.
items.alt: Enzo is a soccer player at Heights

items.title: Houston Christian University to Offer Guaranteed Admissions to Eligible HISD Students
items.summary: The partnership aims to make college more accessible, as HISD students who receive automatic admissions are also guaranteed at least $64,000 in grants through HCU's merit-based scholarships.
items.alt: HISD and HCU officials signing guaranteed admissions partnership
